description: Blazor host that wraps the JavaScript-owned WYSIWYG editing surface of the document editor. Renders the editable page and bridges the JS runtime and .NET across a wide event surface: dirty/save and undo/redo state, selection and formatting state, page metrics, comments, revisions and suggestions, image upload and validation, zoom, ruler, track changes, and runtime recovery.

parameters.name: AccessibilityAnnouncementChanged
parameters.description: Raised when the JS-owned dirty/save state changes.

parameters.name: ActiveHeadingChanged
parameters.description: Fired when the WYSIWYG runtime reports page metrics.

parameters.name: AllowOfflineClipboardImages
parameters.description: Image validation options used by upload and clipboard image flows.

parameters.name: Author
parameters.description: Optional mention provider for document mention autocomplete.

parameters.name: CommentsChanged
parameters.description: Raised when the JS-owned runtime revision list changes.

parameters.name: CommentSelected
parameters.description: Raised when the JS-owned runtime comment list changes.

parameters.name: DirtyStateChanged
parameters.description: Raised when the JS-owned undo/redo stack state changes.

parameters.name: DocumentPatchGenerated
parameters.description: How tracked changes should be displayed in the JS-owned surface.

parameters.name: DocumentSelectionChanged
parameters.description: Raised when the JS engine reports a new document snapshot (e.g. after explicit save or export).

parameters.name: DocumentSnapshotChanged
parameters.description: Raised when the JS engine generates a patch that should be applied to the document.

parameters.name: FontFamilies
parameters.description: Current editing author used for JS-owned runtime revisions.

parameters.name: FormattingStateChanged
parameters.description: Raised when the JS engine shows or hides the inline mini toolbar.

parameters.name: ImageAssetOptions
parameters.description: Optional image provider for upload and clipboard flows.

parameters.name: ImageProvider
parameters.description: Optional image URL resolver for provider-managed assets.

parameters.name: ImageUploadStateChanged
parameters.description: Raised when the JS editor surface owns a keyboard shortcut that must run through the command registry.

parameters.name: ImageUrlResolver
parameters.description: Host-controlled permissions for the current user.

parameters.name: ImageValidation
parameters.description: Provider-managed image assets available for direct insertion or replacement.

parameters.name: KeyboardCommandRequested
parameters.description: Raised when the user requests save via keyboard.

parameters.name: MentionProvider
parameters.description: Optional token provider for document token autocomplete.

parameters.name: MiniToolbarChanged
parameters.description: Raised when the JS engine requests a table context menu.

parameters.name: PageMetricsChanged
parameters.description: Fired when the JS watchdog reports recovery telemetry or debug detail.

parameters.name: Permissions
parameters.description: Whether the surface is read-only.

parameters.name: ReadOnly
parameters.description: Document snapshot to render in the WYSIWYG surface.

parameters.name: RedoRequested
parameters.description: Raised when the user requests undo via keyboard.

parameters.name: ReviewDisplayMode
parameters.description: Whether live track-changes decorations are enabled in the JS-owned surface.

parameters.name: RevisionReviewRequested
parameters.description: Raised when the JS runtime publishes canonical formatting state for the current selection.

parameters.name: RevisionsChanged
parameters.description: Raised when the JS-owned inline revision UI requests accept or reject.

parameters.name: RevisionSelected
parameters.description: Raised when the user selects a comment anchor inside the JS-owned surface.

parameters.name: RuntimeDraftStateJson
parameters.description: Raised when the JS-owned editor has an accessibility status announcement.

parameters.name: RuntimeRecovered
parameters.description: Fired when an image upload starts (true) or finishes (false).

parameters.name: RuntimeRecoveryDetailChanged
parameters.description: Fired when the JS watchdog fails to recover the runtime after an error.

parameters.name: RuntimeRecoveryFailed
parameters.description: Fired when the JS watchdog successfully recovers the runtime after an error.

parameters.name: SaveRequested
parameters.description: Raised when the user requests redo via keyboard.

parameters.name: ShowRuler
parameters.description: Font families allowed by the host editor.

parameters.name: Suggestions
parameters.description: Whether page-width zoom mode is active.

parameters.name: TableContextMenuRequested
parameters.description: Raised when the JS engine requests a text context menu.

parameters.name: TextContextMenuRequested
parameters.description: Raised when the JS engine reports selection change.

parameters.name: TokenProvider
parameters.description: Whether clipboard images can be kept as local draft assets when no image provider is available.

parameters.name: TrackChangesEnabled
parameters.description: Pending provider-backed suggestions to decorate in the WYSIWYG surface.

parameters.name: TransactionCommitted
parameters.description: Raised when the user selects a revision marker inside the JS-owned surface.

parameters.name: UndoRequested
parameters.description: Serialized JS-owned offline runtime state to restore after loading an offline draft.

parameters.name: UndoStateChanged
parameters.description: Raised when a typing transaction is committed.

parameters.name: ZoomPageWidth
parameters.description: Current page zoom percentage.

parameters.name: ZoomPercent
parameters.description: Whether the page ruler should be visible.
